001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat.threat;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableShipStatsAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAIConfig;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipwideAIFlags.AIFlags;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.WeaponAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.WeaponAPI.WeaponType;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Personalities;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
011
012public class IncursionModeSystemScript extends BaseEnergyLashActivatedSystem {
013        
014        public static String INCURSION_MODE = "incursion_mode"; 
015        
016        public static float SPEED_BONUS = 100f;
017        public static float FLUX_DISSIPATION_MULT = 3f;
018        public static float AMMO_REGEN_MULT = 5f;
019        
020        
021        protected ShipAIConfig origConfig; 
022        
023        protected void init(ShipAPI ship) {
024                super.init(ship);
025                if (ship.getShipAI() != null && ship.getShipAI().getConfig() != null) {
026                        ShipAIConfig config = ship.getShipAI().getConfig();
027                        origConfig = config.clone();
028                }
029        }
030        
031        public void applyImpl(ShipAPI ship, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id, State state, float effectLevel) {
032                stats.getMaxSpeed().modifyFlat(id, SPEED_BONUS * effectLevel);
033                stats.getAcceleration().modifyFlat(id, 2f * SPEED_BONUS * effectLevel);
034                stats.getDeceleration().modifyFlat(id, 2f * SPEED_BONUS * effectLevel);
035                stats.getEnergyAmmoRegenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f + (AMMO_REGEN_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel);
036                stats.getBallisticAmmoRegenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f + (AMMO_REGEN_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel);
037                //stats.getMissileAmmoRegenMult().modifyMult(id, AMMO_REGEN_MULT * effectLevel);
038                stats.getFluxDissipation().modifyMult(id, 1f + (FLUX_DISSIPATION_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel);
039                
040                if (ship.getShipAI() != null && ship.getShipAI().getConfig() != null) {
041                        ShipAIConfig config = ship.getShipAI().getConfig();
042                        if (effectLevel > 0) {
043                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.RECKLESS;
044                                config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
045                                config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
046                                config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
047                                config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
048                        } else {
049                                config.copyFrom(origConfig);
050                        }
051                }
052                
053                ship.removeTag(INCURSION_MODE);
054                
055                //if (state != State.IDLE && state != State.OUT) return;
056                if (effectLevel <= 0f) return;
057                
058                ship.addTag(INCURSION_MODE);
059                
060                ship.getEngineController().extendFlame(ship.getSystem(), 1f * effectLevel, 0f * effectLevel, 0.5f * effectLevel);
061                
062                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF, 1f);
063                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_VENT, 1f);
064                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.IGNORES_ORDERS, 1f);
065                
066                makeAllGroupsAutofireOneFrame(ship);
067                
068                setStandardJitter(ship, state, effectLevel);
069        }
070        
071        
072        public StatusData getStatusData(int index, State state, float effectLevel) {
073                if (effectLevel <= 0f) return null;
074                
075                if (index == 0) {
076                        return new StatusData("improved maneuverability", false);
077                } else if (index == 1) {
078                        return new StatusData("+" + (int)SPEED_BONUS + " top speed", false);
079                } else if (index == 2) {
080                        return new StatusData("x" + (int)FLUX_DISSIPATION_MULT+ " flux dissipation", false);
081                } else if (index == 3) {
082                        return new StatusData("rapid charge regen", false);
083                }
084                return null;
085        }
086
087        @Override
088        public float getCurrentUsefulnessLevel(ShipAPI overseer, ShipAPI ship) {
089                if (ship.getSystem().isActive() || ship.getSystem().isChargedown() ||
090                                ship.getSystem().isChargeup() || ship.getSystem().isCoolingDown()) {
091                        return 0f;
092                }
093                
094                Object test = ship.getAIFlags().getCustom(AIFlags.MANEUVER_TARGET);
095                if (test instanceof ShipAPI) {
096                        ShipAPI target = (ShipAPI) test;
097                        
098                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), target.getLocation());
099                        dist -= ship.getCollisionRadius() + target.getCollisionRadius();
100                        
101                        float range = getNonMissileWeaponRange(ship);
102                        float extra = 750f;
103                        if (dist < range + extra) {
104                                float distToOverseer = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), overseer.getLocation());
105                                distToOverseer -= ship.getCollisionRadius() + overseer.getCollisionRadius();
106                                float overseerDistFactor = 0f;
107                                if (distToOverseer < 1000f) {
108                                        float min = 500f;
109                                        overseerDistFactor = (1f - Math.max(0f, distToOverseer - min) / (1000f - min)) * 0.25f;
110                                }
111                                return Math.min(1f, 0.5f + Math.min(0.5f, ship.getFluxLevel() * 1f) + overseerDistFactor);
112                        }
113                }
114                
115                return 0f;
116        }
117        
118        
119        public static float getNonMissileWeaponRange(ShipAPI ship) {
120                float max = 0f;
121                for (WeaponAPI w : ship.getAllWeapons()) {
122                        if (w.isDecorative()) continue;
123                        if (w.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE) continue;
124                        max = Math.max(max, w.getRange());
125                }
126                return max;
127        }
128        
129}
